A [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] '''individual''' was one of a pair of guards posted at the main gate of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Raidos]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Teth/Legends|Teth]].<ref name="Tethan">''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure]]''</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Barabel sentry appeared in [[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure|''Tethan Battle Adventure'']], a [[2010]] entry in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny]]'' series of choose-your-own-adventure books.<ref name="Tethan" />
